title: Lack of Consent
description: The homeowner may not fully understand or consent to the data being shared with the Home Hub, leading to a lack of informed consent regarding their personal data.

title: Inadequate Data Protection
description: The Home Hub may inadequately protect the data received from the homeowner, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Home Hub may misuse the data collected from the homeowner for purposes other than those originally intended or disclosed.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The Home Hub may unintentionally share the homeowner's data with third parties without proper notification or consent.

title: Linkability Threat
description: The guest user may be linked to their actions or identity through the temporary access code they enter, which could be observed or intercepted by unauthorized parties.

title: Data Disclosure Threat
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently disclose the guest user's identity or access patterns if the data is not properly secured or if logs are maintained without adequate privacy measures.

title: Interception Threat
description: The data flow of the temporary access code could be intercepted during transmission, allowing unauthorized parties to gain access to the Home Hub.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Home Hub (P1) may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to trigger events that are logged in the Local Event Log (DS1). This could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive event data.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may store sensitive motion/door/sensor events without proper encryption or security measures, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may retain event data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of sensitive information.

title: Loss of Control over Personal Data
description: The Home Hub (P1) may inadvertently share more data than intended when uploading recorded camera clips to the Cloud Video Storage (DS2), leading to potential loss of control over personal data.

title: Inadequate Data Access Controls
description: The Cloud Video Storage (DS2) may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to access the uploaded camera clips, leading to potential identity theft or misuse of personal data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Cloud Video Storage (DS2) may retain uploaded camera clips longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches over time.

title: Excessive Exposure of Personal Data
description: The Home Hub forwards a real-time motion alert which may contain personal data, potentially exposing it to external parties known and anticipated at design time, or inadvertently broadcasting it, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Inadequate Authentication
description: The mobile app backend may not have strong authentication mechanisms in place, allowing unauthorized users to receive notifications meant for the homeowner.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The homeowner's device may not securely handle the received notifications, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The homeowner's device may retain notifications longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unintended Disclosure
description: The notification may inadvertently disclose sensitive information to unauthorized parties if the homeowner's device is compromised or accessed by others.

title: Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently share more detailed device-usage analytics than intended, leading to potential exposure of sensitive user information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The cloud analytics vendor may store the aggregated analytics in an insecure manner, making it susceptible to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The cloud analytics vendor may use the aggregated device-usage analytics for purposes not agreed upon, such as selling the data to third parties.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The cloud analytics vendor may retain the aggregated analytics longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: Violation of storage limitation principle
description: Personal data is stored longer than needed when the mobile app backend retrieves the video clip for playback.
